description:
Almatafi brings research, NASA data, software and design together to make fire data easier to understand.

Yassin Ali Salah — Research & methodology
Ahmed Hany Khedr — FIRMS data, cleaning & grids
Khalid Osam Mohamed — Harmonization & validation
Fatema Yehia Mohammed — UX research & map/calendar design
Hamza Abdelrahman Mohamed — API, web app & deployment
Rowaina Elsharkawy — Visual design, storytelling & demo
